name: Opposite-Edge Endpoint Connector Controls
definition: Three verified connector families instantiate the opposite-edge criterion: two have positive relative-edge behavior, while the third has two bad relative edges and is tested both before and after restoring the missing cube corner.
parameters: The bad connector has complete negative endpoint certificates with 25 states before restoration and 125 states afterward. The verification enumerates the five possible removed-vertex sets inside the three-cube and all 20 first-boundary corner exclusions.
properties: All controls satisfy the equivalence between the endpoint in the full family, the endpoint after deleting the opposite corner, and the two transverse-restriction criterion.
